objective: Freeze a benchmark-independent V1 contract for agreement among project metadata, installed distributions, environment markers, selected extras, and resolver evidence.

evidence_contract.project: A provenance-matched installed project distribution with a valid composite metadata SHA-256.
evidence_contract.requirements: Exact Requires-Dist strings from that same metadata snapshot.
evidence_contract.installed: Canonical distribution names and PEP 440 versions observed under the same Python executable.
evidence_contract.environment: An explicit PEP 508 marker environment captured under the same Python executable.
evidence_contract.extras: An explicit set of selected extras; no test/dev extra is inferred from path names.
evidence_contract.resolver: Direct argv `python -m pip check`, network disabled, with exit code and stdout/stderr hashes.

decision_contract.pass: Project provenance is valid, every active declared requirement has one compatible installed distribution, and the observed pip check exits zero.
decision_contract.fail: An active requirement is missing/incompatible/ambiguous, metadata is malformed, an installed version is invalid, or pip check exits nonzero.
decision_contract.unknown: Project provenance, marker environment, resolver outcome, or another required evidence field is absent.
decision_contract.marker_semantics: Evaluate base requirements with extra='', and optional requirements against each explicitly selected extra. Inactive markers do not create obligations.

prohibitions: No host-environment marker evaluation for container evidence
No parsing pip-check prose to override its exit status
synthetic_counterexamples: Missing resolver evidence is unknown, not pass.
A false platform marker creates no obligation.
An extra requirement is active only when that exact extra is selected.
Missing, incompatible, duplicate, or invalid installed versions fail.
A nonzero pip-check outcome fails even when declared project requirements appear satisfied.
